statement: Let Y be the complex blow-up of CP1 × CP1 at {0, ∞} × {0, ∞}. There is a circle-invariant Kähler form ωY for which the lifted diagonal circle action is Hamiltonian. Its half-turn gY has fixed locus precisely the four exceptional curves E1, . . . , E4, each isomorphic to CP1 . Along these curves, dgY is the identity on the tangent bundle and minus the identity on the symplectic normal bundle. Moreover, Y is simply connected and its integral homology is (4.3) Hi(Y ; Z) ∼ =        Z, i = 0, 4, Z6, i = 2, 0, otherwise.
